summary: A control modulator that moves other machines' parameters with random steps, sample-and-hold, 1/f-like drift or chaotic Lorenz trajectories: up to 8 targets (any parameter of any machine), each with its own depth, polarity, range and curve, written smoothly and never as an undo step. Free rate in Hz or tempo-synced from 8 bars to 1/64 (straight, dotted or triplet), probability, chaos amount, smoothing, depth, signed bias, unipolar or bipolar range, quantisation, reproducible seeds and beat, bar or note retriggering. Use it for evolving filter movement, glitchy stepped modulation, subtle humanisation and deterministic chaotic sweeps on any machine.
use_for: Move any machine's parameters with random steps, sample-and-hold, 1/f drift or chaos: up to 8 targets, smoothly, with probability, quantisation and reproducible seeds.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: The modulation source: random, sample and hold, 1/f drift or Lorenz chaos
parameters.how: Chooses which random or chaotic generator drives the output.
parameters.sound: Random steps or glides between uniform values, sample and hold gates updates by probability, drift wanders slowly and chaos orbits a Lorenz attractor.

parameters.name: Rate
parameters.description: Steps or orbit speed per second when Sync is Free
parameters.how: Sets the modulation speed from 0.02 to 40 Hz while Sync is Free.
parameters.sound: Low rates create slow ambient motion, mid rates give rhythmic steps or wobble and high rates produce rapid flutter.

parameters.name: Sync
parameters.description: Free: Rate in Hz. Otherwise one step lasts this long at the song's tempo
parameters.how: Locks step timing and drift or chaos speed to the song's tempo, from 8 bars down to 1/64.
parameters.sound: Synced steps land on the musical grid so random filter jumps and gates lock to the beat.

parameters.name: Feel
parameters.description: Straight, dotted (1.5 times longer), triplet (two thirds as long) or quintuplet (four fifths as long) when Sync is on
parameters.how: Stretches a synced step to 1.5 times (dotted) or shrinks it to two thirds (triplet) or four fifths (quintuplet) while Sync is on.
parameters.sound: Dotted and triplet subdivisions give stepped modulation an off-beat lilt against straight grooves.

parameters.name: Probability
parameters.description: Chance that a Sample and hold step picks a new value (0 to 100 %)
parameters.how: Sets the percentage chance that each step in Sample and hold mode draws a fresh value instead of holding.
parameters.sound: At 100 % every step moves, while lower values hold notes longer and create sparse, glitchy jumps.

parameters.name: Chaos
parameters.description: Calm periodic orbit (0 %) to deep double-scroll Lorenz chaos (100 %)
parameters.how: Blends Chaos mode from a calm periodic orbit at 0 % into a deep double-scroll Lorenz attractor at 100 %.
parameters.sound: Low values sway gently and predictably while high values flip unpredictably between bright and dark lobes.

parameters.name: Smooth
parameters.description: 0 %: crisp steps. 100 %: smooth curves through waypoints or continuous flow
parameters.how: Interpolates between consecutive random or sampled values with a raised-cosine glide, or smooths drift and chaos flow.
parameters.sound: Zero produces sharp stair-steps while 100 % turns steps into fluid curves and continuous Lorenz swirls.

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: Scales the width of the modulation output (0 to 100 %)
parameters.how: Scales how far the output swings around Bias before reaching the target slots.
parameters.sound: Low depth gives subtle humanisation and high depth sweeps the full modulation span.

parameters.name: Bias
parameters.description: Shifts the output centre or floor (-100 % to +100 %)
parameters.how: Offsets the output centre in Bipolar mode or the floor in Unipolar mode before clamping to 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Positive bias keeps modulation toward brighter or higher values while negative bias pulls it lower.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Unipolar swings upward from Bias; Bipolar centres symmetrically around 50 % + Bias
parameters.how: Selects whether the shaped output rises upward from Bias (Unipolar) or swings symmetrically around the middle (Bipolar).
parameters.sound: Bipolar centres wandering around a target's setting while Unipolar pushes modulation in one direction from the floor.

parameters.name: Quantise
parameters.description: 0: off (continuous). 1 to 32: snaps the output to N evenly spaced levels
parameters.how: Snaps the generator output onto N evenly spaced discrete levels when set from 1 to 32 (0 turns quantisation off).
parameters.sound: Two levels create binary random gates while twelve levels produce crisp chromatic-style stepped jumps.

parameters.name: Seed
parameters.description: 0: fresh sequence every run. 1 to 9999: repeats the exact same sequence
parameters.how: Picks a deterministic starting seed from 1 to 9999 for bit-exact repeats, or 0 for a new sequence every time.
parameters.sound: Fixed seeds make random modulation repeatable on every playback and render while 0 stays surprising on every take.

parameters.name: Retrigger
parameters.description: Free: runs on. Beat, Bar or Note: restarts phase and re-seeds (or steps) on the trigger
parameters.how: Restarts the phase and deterministic seed (or forces a fresh step when Seed is 0) on each beat, bar or listened note.
parameters.sound: Beat and bar retriggers lock fixed-seed random phrases into repeating loops while Note retrigger gives every note a fresh jump.

parameters.name: Write glide
parameters.description: Least time a target takes to cross its whole range: no write moves further than this allows
parameters.how: Limits how fast each target parameter may move so writes never step faster than this full-range travel time.
parameters.sound: Short glides keep stepped jumps snappy and click-free while long glides turn sudden jumps into slow sweeps.
